title: mgmt_stream_open
description: Hub to agent (request), feature mgmt_tunnel (PLAN.md S20). Opens a Server-Sent-Events endpoint of the management API. The result data has the shape mgmt_stream_open_result_data in defs.schema.json (sid).

query.description: Decoded query parameters of the endpoint, name to value. Optional; added in T912 without a version change because receivers ignore unknown members.
